subject.title: feat(autoreview): mixed Bedrock/ChatGPT provider auth with reviewer isolation

question: Should the shared autoreview skill make independently selectable Bedrock/ChatGPT and Claude subscription auth modes part of its supported public CLI and configuration contract?
rationale: The patch is a substantial feature extension with new flags and provider-specific behavior; code review alone cannot choose the supported compatibility and maintenance boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the auth contract
options.body: Accept the new explicit auth modes as supported behavior, subject to redacted runtime proof of isolation and mixed-provider execution.

options.title: Keep provider routing external
options.body: Retain the current generic reviewer configuration and ask for a smaller integration path if the repository should not own provider-specific auth policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the auth contract
recommendation.body: Accept the new explicit auth modes as supported behavior, subject to redacted runtime proof of isolation and mixed-provider execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical trail connects steipete to the shared autoreview feature and its user-facing documentation.
